gloss: lost item; something one has lost

definitions.gloss: lost item; something one has lost
definitions.explanation: An item the owner has misplaced and whose whereabouts are unknown. Compare with {落|お}とし{物|もの} (a dropped item, typically found by someone else).

examples.japanese: {失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧や⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I've been losing a lot of things lately — keys, wallets — and it's becoming a problem.

notes:
Compound of {失|な}くす (to lose) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). The connecting い of the verb stem is dropped.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lose something
- {失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧: a lost item is found
- {失|な}くし{物|もの}⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦タグ→タグ：11034_tagu⟧: lost-item prevention tag (e.g., AirTag)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧: a dropped/found item — emphasis on having been dropped, often found and turned in by others. Lost-and-found offices are ⟦{落|お}とし{物|もの}→落とし物：08450_otoshimono⟧{係|がかり}, not {失|な}くし{物|もの}{係|がかり}.
- ⟦{忘|わす}れ{物|もの}→忘れ物：01758_wasuremono⟧: a forgotten item — left behind somewhere (in a store, on a train); the owner usually knows where they left it.
